2. In your opinion do you feel that Mr Shepherd’s current condition is temporary, episodic or permanent
in nature? What is the expected duration of the current restrictions?
Episodic, with symptom exacerbation linked to stressor exposure. The restrictions below are expected to remain
necessary for at least the next 3-6 months, subject to treatment response and 8-weekly review.
3. Based on your current assessment, what work capacity (including number of shifts, hours, and type
of duties) would best support Mr Shepherd’s recovery while minimising risk of exacerbation?
Six 8-hour shifts per fortnight (of the ten rostered in a full-time fortnight), comprising:
(a) No more than two weekday day/afternoon shifts. These shifts carry the peak call volume and the majority of
complaints — the identified stressors. Retaining two per fortnight maintains graded exposure to the full role and
preserves work capacity; the cap prevents multiple high-load shifts accumulating within a fortnight, which is the
pattern associated with symptom exacerbation.
(b) Two weekend day shifts. Weekend call volume and complaint exposure are materially lower while the duties
are identical, allowing the same work to be performed at an intensity consistent with Mr Shepherd’s current
concentration and working-memory capacity, and preserving a normal sleep-wake cycle.
(c) No more than two night shifts at this stage. Night shifts are low in volume and complaints, but a stable sleep
routine is central to symptom management following cessation of the night-time medication; capping nights
protects that routine and limits cumulative fatigue. This cap is suitable for reassessment at review.
This reduced pattern of approximately six shifts per fortnight is the pattern Mr Shepherd has in fact worked and
tolerated over the past twelve months without deterioration, and maintaining rather than increasing it best
supports recovery while minimising risk of exacerbation. Usual switchboard operational duties remain suitable:
complaint-handling duties are excluded as below.
4. Are there any specific workplace modifications or supports you would recommend (e.g. reduced
workload, predictable rostering, supervision level, reduced exposure to stressors) to assist Mr
Shepherd during this period?
(a) No complaint-handling duties — complaints received at the Switchboard to be logged and redirected, not
